$comment: Template of a compare corpus (schema sigil-compare-corpus/1): what Sigil's compare mode (bench/compare.rs, plan T6) scores Sigil against the other voice changers on. A compare run names it as compare.corpus; every path is relative to this file's folder.

Audio never goes into the repository. Build a corpus with scripts/bench/fetch-public-corpus.py (LibriSpeech test-clean and CMU ARCTIC with EGG truth, about 92 clips, written to %LOCALAPPDATA%/sigil-dev-cache/corpus/public-v1) or scripts/bench/make-test-clips.py --local-corpus (the dev cache's speech clips); consented recordings of real people may be added as clips too (local only).

clips: id (used as {clip} in point paths), input, its sha256 (checked), optional f0_truth (scripts/vc-bench/egg_f0.py CSV: tracker-independent truth, before the transpose) and references (neutral upstream renders from scripts/vc-bench/rvc_offline_reference.py, one per noise seed). DNSMOS is scored only on clips of 9.01 s or more; at a paired SD of 0.21 the +0.05 DNSMOS row needs about 68 clips (50 % power).

points: the other systems' operating points, one WAV per clip ({clip} in wav), each with the JSON sidecar its scripts/vc-bench driver wrote next to it (<wav>.json: config, input and voice sha256, per-block compute, GPU, latency). tier offline = a driver's block loop over the file; live = recorded through the devices (a captures entry, or play_record.py). Points whose transpose or voice differ from the corpus's are refused; offline points count only when their per-block p99 compute is below their block period on the run's GPU.

captures: record a live point's WAVs with Sigil's play-and-record meter (plays every clip on meter.output_device: record must be true; only missing WAVs unless overwrite). Start the system under test first (another app, or Sigil's own voice changer) with its input on the cable the meter plays to.

sigil.points: extra in-process Sigil rows, the spec's engine and stream with fields replaced; role ablation rows are paired with the row they ablate (versus) and never counted as competitors. Sigil's named configurations come from the compare run's sigil.configs (shipping_default, autotuned, low_latency, quality).

margins are fixed before the run (the defaults are the plan's: DNSMOS +0.05 superiority, non-inferiority 0.05 DNSMOS / 0.005 GPE / 0.1 dB MCD / 0.01 speaker similarity, latency 0.7x). stand_in_references renders the spec's own voice offline as references for a dry run before upstream renders exist (neutral between Sigil's rows, not between engines).
